init.title: PodView screen access
init.description: Pair one browser with a configured room, or revoke its access. Only a Home Assistant administrator can do this.

confirm.title: Confirm screen access
confirm.description: {action}: **{room}**. Pairing replaces previous screen access for this room. Access lasts up to 30 days; you can revoke it here at any time.

paired.title: Pair the screen
paired.description:
Room: **{room}**. Open **Pair screen** in PodView on the browser you want to use, and enter this code once:

`{code}`

The code expires after 10 minutes. This browser can remain paired for up to 30 days. To remove its access, choose **Revoke screen access** in these settings. Do not share the code.

revoked.title: Screen access revoked
revoked.description: Screen access for **{room}** has been revoked. Pair the browser again to give it access.

abort.admin_required: An active Home Assistant administrator must open and complete this flow.
abort.no_rooms: No configured physical PodVoice room is available.
abort.request_finished: This request has already been submitted. Start again only if you want to replace the previous screen access.
abort.request_unconfirmed: The request could not be confirmed. No pairing code can be shown. Check the add-on status before starting a new request.
